source.name: Bundesagentur für Arbeit – Jobbörse
source.note: Jobs of every working time for the job titles career-changer courses train for (data/kurs_radar.yaml), Bundesagentur postings only, a snapshot. Titles with many postings are a sample of the most relevant ones (`sampled`); job texts are analysed but not published.

method.pay: Salary per year from the Bundesagentur's salary fields or the posting's text (a monthly salary times 12; ranges by their midpoint; caps like 'up to' and unclear amounts ignored). Full-time postings only: minijobs, part-time-only postings and those stating fewer than 30 hours a week are left out. Each role (company + title) counts once. Medians need at least 10 roles from 5 employers and a 95% confidence interval no wider than a quarter of the median.
method.no_german: German is not mentioned in an English posting, is explicitly not required, or is only 'a plus'.
